title: The Business Rule That Stops You Working For Free
hook_text: MOST SMALL BUSINESS OWNERS PAY THEMSELVES LAST

beats.say: Most small business owners pay themselves last.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a lone fountain pen resting on a dark, rain-slicked concrete ledger at night.

beats.say: Every month, revenue hits the business account.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a massive concrete bridge pier cutting through a heavy twilight fog.

beats.say: Suppliers get paid. Software gets paid. Ads get paid.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a solitary silhouette walking across a vast, empty industrial rail yard under sodium lights.

beats.say: And what is left at the bottom belongs to the owner.
beats.visual: High angle shot of single practical light illuminating a wet, empty asphalt parking lot.

beats.say: Why do millions of business owners run on empty?
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a heavy steel warehouse door slowly closing against a cold blue hour sky.

beats.say: Most people assume owner pay is whatever is left over after expenses.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing at the edge of a sheer concrete roof against an overcast skyline.

beats.say: That is the trap that keeps a business alive while the owner starves.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of heavy machinery gears turning in cold fluorescent light.

beats.say: How do you break out of that cycle this week?
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a towering concrete dam wall under heavy gray rain.

beats.say: You treat your own salary as a fixed operating expense.
beats.visual: Single practical light cutting through deep shadows in an empty brick corridor.

beats.say: Before a single vendor is paid, owner pay is planned into the budget.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a dark industrial harbor with crane silhouettes against a winter horizon.

beats.say: The honest catch is that fixed owner pay forces you to cut weak expenses fast.
beats.visual: Raindrops hitting the dark, reflective surface of a deserted highway at night.

beats.say: Pay yourself first because a business built on your free labor is just a job you cannot quit.
beats.visual: A lone figure walking away into the fog under a single amber sodium streetlamp.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a heavy steel latch clicking shut in cold blue light.

caption: Most small business owners treat their own paycheck as a leftover. Flip the rule and treat owner pay as a fixed expense. #smallbusiness #moneypsychology #businessowner #wealth
description: Why small business owners pay themselves last and how treating owner pay as a fixed operating expense changes the game.
first_comment: Are you paying yourself first or taking whatever is left at the end of the month?
